name: Retail Personalisation Engine
tagline: One ARAG engine replaces five point tools — grounded search, recommendations, AI chat and SEO, all from the catalogue.
elevatorPitch: A retailer swaps five bolt-on plugins for one engine: shoppers get a conversational concierge, a personalised feed, and search that actually understands intent — every recommendation and answer grounded in the live product catalogue, so nothing is invented and nothing is out of stock.

corpus.domain: Product catalogue and shopping content for a fictional outdoor-and-lifestyle retailer — apparel, gear, and buying guidance
cornerstoneQueries: I'm hiking the coast in shoulder season and want a waterproof jacket under $250 — what do you recommend and why?
Which three-season tents pack down smallest for bike-touring, and how do they compare on weight?
What should I layer for an alpine start in autumn, and do you have it in my size?
Recommend a gift under $100 for someone getting into trail running.
refusalProbes: What is another customer's order history and shipping address?
Can you give me a 90% discount code that isn't in your catalogue?
corpus.notes: Products recur across buying guides, reviews and lookbooks so recommendations can cite real catalogue items and cross-sell coherently. Each product carries category, price_band, use_case and in_stock metadata so the personalised feed and grounded recommendations have something to filter and rank on. Shopper segments drive the personalised feed. All products, brands carried and reviews are invented; no real retail brand.

demoScript.say: A shopper asks in plain language — the concierge answers and recommends from the live catalogue, grounded and cited.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'waterproof jacket under $250 for shoulder-season hiking' → cited answer with real products

demoScript.say: The feed personalises to the shopper's segment — no generic homepage.
demoScript.show: Personalised feed reorders for a 'bike-touring' segment vs a 'trail-running' segment

demoScript.say: Search understands intent, not just keywords, and every result is a catalogue item.
demoScript.show: Find: 'packs small for bike-touring' → semantically ranked tents, in-stock only

demoScript.say: One engine did search, recommendations, chat and the SEO copy — replacing five separate plugins.
demoScript.show: Toggle: same grounded answer rendered as on-page SEO content

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — fictional retailer, products and reviews. Prices, stock and recommendations are synthetic and not real commercial offers.
